entry.title: [org.springframework:spring-expression] Spring Framework Denial of Service via Unbounded Cache in SpEL
entry.content:
Applications which accept user-supplied Spring Expression Language (SpEL) expressions may be vulnerable to a Denial of Service (DoS) attack if the evaluation of a SpEL expression triggers unbounded cache growth.

Affected versions: Spring Framework 7.0.0 through 7.0.7; 6.2.0 through 6.2.18; 6.1.0 through 6.1.27; 5.3.0 through 5.3.48.

References

  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-41851
  • https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41851
  • https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/commit/2c18c33ce0f89bf718c184190cfb7ed49b4276fb
  • https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/commit/76a36dfd707cddbe7118a81c2e055b36501d2cff
  • https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/releases/tag/v6.2.19
  • https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/releases/tag/v7.0.8
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-wxpp-56q6-5pcg

entry.title: [org.springframework:spring-webflux] Spring Framework Path Traversal via Versioned Static Resources in Spring MVC and WebFlux
entry.content:
Spring MVC and WebFlux applications are vulnerable to Path Traversal attacks when resolving static resources.

Affected versions: Spring Framework 7.0.0 through 7.0.7; 6.2.0 through 6.2.18; 6.1.0 through 6.1.27; 5.3.0 through 5.3.48.
